risks.title: Dependence on commercial paper markets
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on commercial paper programs for short-term liquidity. The risk is explicitly mentioned with strong language regarding the impact of a credit rating downgrade or unfavorable market conditions.

risks.title: Risk of rising borrowing costs
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes that any credit rating downgrade would lead to higher borrowing costs. While the current situation is stable, the risk is recurring and linked to volatile external factors.

risks.title: Short-term debt repayment
risks.score_rationale: 899.5 million dollars in short-term debt as of December 31, 2025. The amount is significant and represents substantial pressure on cash flow.

risks.title: Limited access to capital markets
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly links access to capital markets to credit ratings and overall economic conditions. Repeated mention across multiple paragraphs, with a concerned tone on potential impacts.

risks.title: Dependence on a revolving credit facility
risks.score_rationale: The 2.0 billion dollar credit facility expires on October 18, 2027 and is described as essential to support commercial paper programs. Its expiration and central role in commercial paper ratings make it a critical point.

ai_positioning.summary: Fortive explicitly mentions the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning into its acceleration strategy (Fortive Accelerated strategy). The company incorporates these technologies into the Fortive Business System as 'technological enablers' to accelerate innovation and generate more recurring customer value.
evidence: In doing so, we have incorporated new technology enablers, like artificial intelligence and machine learning and are building new capabilities to drive accelerated innovation, greater commercial success and more recurring customer value.
